question: Should OpenClaw continue the Wave 2+ modular-dashboard roadmap as staged bundled dashboard work, and which subitems should be moved to plugin, skill, or ClawHub distribution instead?
rationale: The issue spans bundled UI, plugin SDK, persistent state, browser sandboxing, command/data bindings, and distribution boundaries that require maintainer product and security intent before implementation can safely proceed.

options.title: Sponsor staged bundled dashboard work
options.body: Keep this tracker open, review the linked work in dependency order, and require explicit storage, sandbox, permission, and upgrade proof for each stage.

options.title: Narrow to extension APIs
options.body: Keep only missing generic plugin/widget SDK seams in OpenClaw and ask optional widgets, skills, galleries, and app bundles to prove themselves through external plugin packages or ClawHub first.

options.title: Pause the roadmap
options.body: Defer or close the umbrella and linked implementation stack if maintainers do not want bundled dashboard work in the current product cycle.

recommendation.title: Sponsor staged bundled dashboard work
recommendation.body: Keep this tracker open, review the linked work in dependency order, and require explicit storage, sandbox, permission, and upgrade proof for each stage.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest current-main ownership signal is the recently merged plugin-tab seam and Logbook precedent that this roadmap builds on.
